growth.note: The bound applies to every fixture measured at more than one size, and it is 1.25 because the cost per plan entry has to stay flat as the fleet grows: `fleet` grows the number of entries and keeps each entry's own work constant, `mesh` grows one entry's work with the fleet and keeps the plan linear in it, and a quarter of slack absorbs constant-factor noise without admitting any super-linear term.

worked.note: Moved by hold-declaration-shape-and-fold-set-reads: every member whose deployment wrote a knob is read a second time for its slot names, the interface value carries a `fold` field, and a set-valued read binds its entry-keyed set before delivering it. Every gated counter rose, by 0.05% at fleet-256 and mesh-256 and by at most 2.2% at the smallest fixtures, so the figures are re-recorded rather than the margin widened.
